content.short: Oceanpoint is Blocksquare's tokenization infrastructure for real estate assets.
content.description: Oceanpoint is a tokenization platform for real estate assets that enables businesses of all sizes to create, launch, and manage real estate investment marketplaces with ease. It also offers tokenization-as-a-service to asset owners. As an open-end DAO, Oceanpoint can potentially own an unlimited pool of real estate asset tokens, inviting broad participation and giving members the opportunity to earn by contributing to a DeFi protocol backed by the real estate economy.
